newsitem.title: USA: Carrington restates Q4 and year-end EPS. [CORRECTED 00:49 GMT 30/4]
newsitem.headline: Carrington restates Q4 and year-end EPS. [CORRECTED 00:49 GMT 30/4]

text.p: Carrington Laboratories Inc said it restated its loss per common share for the fourth quarter and year-ended December 31, 1996 in response to a Securities and Exchange Commission's review of its Form 10-K annual report.

The company said restated loss per share were $0.11 and $0.74 (corrects from "earnings" to "restated loss per share") for the fourth quarter and year end, respectively, instead of $0.00 and $0.63 as previously reported.

In the SEC's opinion the discount in the conversion price of the company's Series E Convertible Preferred Stock is a part of preferred stock yield and should be accounted for in the fourth quarter of 1996 as a dividend to the shareholders, it said.
Carrington said it amended its Form 10-K report for 1996 to reflect a preferred stock dividend as a reduction of earnings per common share.
These changes have no effect on its cash position or reported profits, it said.
